name: TLL OS Engineering Foundation Version Manifest
description: Version manifest for the TLL OS AI Native Engineering Foundation. Tracks the version of all .tll-engine/ components and their hash chain.

identity.note: Identity system in bootstrap phase. Ed25519 key-based identity pending P0-15.19. Current identity is git-commit-author based.

truth.note: Truth files in bootstrap phase. Structure and schema established. Full population with fine-grained data is future work.

protocol.note: Protocol v0.1 in bootstrap phase. 8-phase development workflow, testing standards, and audit procedure defined. Enforcement via CI hooks is future work.

cognition.note: Engineering Cognition Graph in bootstrap phase. NOT a neural network. Structure and schema established with example nodes/edges/decisions. Full population and query API is future work.

evidence.note: Evidence system in bootstrap phase. Schema established with 3 example evidence records. Automated evidence collection from CI is future work.

immutable_core_rules: P004: Bug only, no Runtime modification without evidence
P005: No test standard lowering for CI green
P010: First Principle: TLL is a high frame rate programming language
known_limitations: Ed25519 identity not yet implemented (pending P0-15.19)
CI enforcement of protocol not yet implemented (future work)
Automated evidence collection from CI not yet implemented
Full population of cognition graph not yet complete
Query API for cognition graph not yet implemented
Truth update automation not yet implemented (manual update in bootstrap phase)

next_phases.name: TLL Native Cryptographic Foundation
next_phases.description: Add Ed25519, SHA-512, secure random, Identity primitives, upgrade blockchain signatures from HMAC to Ed25519.

next_phases.name: AI Foundation CI Enforcement
next_phases.description: Add CI validation of .tll-engine/ schema, protocol compliance checks, automated evidence collection.

next_phases.name: Engineering Cognition Query API
next_phases.description: Add query API for cognition graph: What is X? Why? Depends? Proves? Constrains? Changed? Safely change? Must verify?

next_phases.name: tllos.com Official Portal
next_phases.description: Build official website with Truth Browser, Agent Developer Center, and Engineering Cognition Graph visualization.
next_phases.note: Website comes AFTER foundation is established. Website shows results, foundation makes results.

version_chain.note: Version chain established. Future versions will have parent_hash pointing to previous version's hash.

production_readiness.runtime: READY for development, NOT verified for production memory safety
production_readiness.blockchain: NOT READY for production (missing real cryptography, account state, persistence, chain reorg)
production_readiness.ai_foundation: NOT READY (bootstrap phase, structure established, automation pending)
